21,buildings,"Building palette in builder paint mode",phase2,completed,M,high,"By commit 2268a3c. Buildings tab, buy/place, cost deducted, clubhouse protected."
22,buildings,"Building revenue tick (daily income)",phase2,completed,L,high,"By commit 2268a3c. 30s tick, clubhouse=$50/shop=$25/snack=$15, rep-scaled, indicator."

23,buildings,"Decor building reputation bonuses",phase2,completed,M,medium,"Cron job: processDecorBonuses() alongside revenue tick. Bench=+0.1/Fountain=+0.15/Garden=+0.2, +50% within 3 tiles of tee/cup."
24,buildings,"Building delete mode",phase2,completed,S,high,"By commit 2268a3c. Delete button in tooltip, 50% refund, clubhouse protected."

25,economy,"Day/night cycle — game time + clock UI + phases",phase2,completed,M,medium,"Cron job: gameTimeMinutes in courseStore, advanceGameTime in update(), clock UI top right in playSection, formatGameTimeDisplay helper. Split nighttime spawning + summary into task #26."

26,economy,"Night phase → day transition mechanic",phase2,completed,M,medium,"Night detection (20:00-6:00), stop spawning, wait for active golfers, day transition modal with summary. Added dailyRevenue/dailyExpenses/dailyGolfersCompleted tracking in courseStore, addRevenue/addExpense/addDailyGolferCompleted/resetDayCounters actions. checkNightPhase() in update(), day-modal overlay with Continue button. Split spawn rate tuning into #26b."

27,economy,"Expense tracking + detailed day summary breakdown",phase2,completed,S,medium,"Modified spendMoney() to increment dailyExpenses + track per-category breakdown (terrain/buildings/holes). Added dailyExpenseBreakdown Record to courseStore with categories. Updated addExpense() to accept category param. All 7 spendMoney call sites now pass category. Day summary modal shows per-category expense breakdown sorted by amount."
28,play_mode,"1:1 Challenge Mode — play as a golfer",phase2,completed,L,high,"Already implemented (sidebar button, aim+power bar, opponent tracking, course record, camera follow). Marking completed."

29,polish,"Water splash visual effect",phase3,pending,S,low,"When a ball lands in water, show a visual splash particle effect at the landing tile. Use Phaser particle emitter with blue/white particles that burst upward and fade. Use the isometric tile center as the origin point. Trigger from onBallLanded when tile.type === 'water'. After build: bun run build && git add -A && git commit -m 'add water splash effect' && git push"

30,polish,"Golfer reaction animations (celebration / frustration)",phase3,pending,S,low,"Add visual feedback when golfers react to shots. On birdie or better: scale bounce the golfer sprite + green flash. On water/tree/max strokes: red tint + sprite shake. On par: small nod animation. Use Phaser tweens (scale, tint, shake) triggered in the reacting state transition. After build: bun run build && git add -A && git commit -m 'add golfer reaction animations' && git push"

31,polish,"Deploy to GitHub Pages",phase3,completed,S,medium,"Configured vite.config.ts base='/simgolf-web/', added gh-pages dependency and deploy script. Pushed to gh-pages branch via bun run deploy. Pages already configured at www.chrisbuonocore.com/simgolf-web with gh-pages branch source. Build triggered successfully."

32,polish,"Star rating UI in money bar",pending,pending,S,low,"Add a star rating display next to the money amount in the top-right money display. Render filled/unfilled stars (⭐/☆) based on the current reputation value (1.0=1 star, 5.0=5 stars). Update in real-time as reputation changes via the existing updateMoneyDisplay() flow. After build: bun run build && git add -A && git commit -m 'add star rating to money bar' && git push"

33,economy,"Phase-based spawn rates (morning=slow, peak=fast, evening=taper)",phase2,completed,S,low,"Added updateSpawnParams() in BuilderScene that varies SPAWN_INTERVAL/MAX_GOLFERS/MIN_GOLFERS by getDayPhase(). Morning=15s/6/1, Peak=6s/10/2, Evening=12s/8/1, Night=999999/0/0. Called in update() after clock display."
